a: Established investigators: about 12% below their recent average NIGMS funding. New investigators: typically $275K direct costs per year. Up to $750K per year if well justified; 5 years
dt: Annual due dates Jan 27 and May 27 (through May 2028)
e: Established investigators must hold an active NIGMS single-PI R01-equivalent and apply within their eligibility window. New (non-ESI) investigators without prior NIGMS R01-equivalent funding may also apply. ESIs must use PAR-27-032.
n: NIGMS MIRA (R35) for Established and New Investigators (PAR-26-121)
